system_deps: MuJoCo 2.1 binaries and a C compiler for mujoco-py
install.notes: The install block is the upstream package's (setup.py: mujoco_py 2.0.2.7, gym 0.15.3; MuJoCo 2.1 binaries and a C compiler). The fake backend, the reference and the gate need none of it: fake.py is pure Python and parses the MJCF text. The driver's sim path (a backend name backends does not list) imports the modern mujoco package and loads the same model file; that install was not run here.
